article.detail:
Canva於10月30日介紹北美品牌企劃「What Will You Canva Today?」，以生活與工作情境連結產品用途。

企劃涵蓋電視、戶外、電台及社交素材，由GS&P與內部團隊合作。

首支電視廣告預定美國11月1日於NBC Sunday Night Football播出。

AI創意產品可用具體使用情境解釋價值，避免只展示功能清單。

選一個受眾熟悉的任務，測試以人物選擇串連產品示範。

這是品牌策略案例，並非新AI功能發布；公告未提供銷售或品牌提升結果，首播仍屬計劃。
article.detail_en:
Canva’s October 30 North America campaign announcement uses everyday work and personal scenarios to explain product uses.

GS&P and the in-house team support television, outdoor, radio and social assets.

The first TV spot is scheduled for November 1 US time during NBC Sunday Night Football.

AI creative products can communicate value through specific use situations rather than feature lists.

Choose one familiar task and test a product demonstration driven by human choices.

This is a brand-strategy case, not a new AI feature. No sales or brand-lift result is disclosed; the first broadcast is still scheduled.
